summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for the BoostNet ecosystem: End-to-End Non-Technical User Experience, Desktop System Tray Client (Go binary for Windows), Camera QR Scanner and PAKE pairing on the Android Donor app, Dual Operating Modes (Boost Mode for browsing load-balancing and Download Accelerator Mode for Range-split multi-phone downloads), and Fail-Safe Windows System Proxy lifecycle management with automatic crash recovery.
